VERDICT LOGIC

Calendar threshold

GO

Overall utility ≥ 72, confidence ≥ 0.70, and sales-noise probability < 0.55.

MAYBE

Utility 55–71, or any result with confidence below 0.70. Route to human review.

SKIP

Utility < 55, or sales-noise probability ≥ 0.70 without a strong audience-specific reason.
